static_diagnosis.observed_code: For a new comparison, resultRef is undefined because readByRequest returned no prior result. Successful persist can already create and validate its criterion binding, but analysis uses the pre-persist resultRef to decide whether to read that binding; it therefore skips the read and calls bind again.
static_diagnosis.persistence_behavior: With rules and comparisonBindings present, createPlannerResultPersistence calls bindings.bind after storing, runs its current validation, and calls bindings.read before returning ok. Bind itself returns read after its transaction.
static_diagnosis.contract_limit: The persistence type does not guarantee that every injected implementation/configuration binds. The proposed unconditional read may return non-ok; the existing fallback bind branch remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
static_diagnosis.proposed_behavior: Always ask the canonical bindings.read whether the stored result already has a currently valid binding before deciding to bind. Valid existing binding skips the redundant write attempt; absence or any non-ok status follows the same existing bind branch.
static_diagnosis.runtime_cause_not_proven: This static call-graph finding does not establish that the duplicate bind caused R1/R2 timeout or any runtime failure.
